m: कया ind. (inst. fem. of 2. क) in what manner? RV.

v: strI jamBAsurakanyAyAM hiraRya SipuBAryyATAm “hiraRyakaSiporBAryyA kayADUrnAma dAnavI । jamBasya tanayA dattA suzube caturaH sutAn । saMhrAdaM prAganuhrAdaM prahlAdaM hrAdameva ca” BA॰ 6, 18, 9 ।
a: कयाधूः — f. The wife of Hiraṇyakaśipu and mother of Prahlāda.

m: कयाधु उस् (ऊस् v.l.) f. N. of Hiraṇyakaśipu's wife, BhP. vi, 18, 12 Comm. on TBr.
कया-शुभीय n. the hymn, RV. i, 165 (MaitrS.).
कयाद् v.l. for क्रव्याद्, q.v., SV.

v: tri॰ kim + pfzo॰ vede kayAdeSaH । kiMSabdArTe “na kiM sahantya paryyetA kayasya cit” f॰ 1, 27, 8 । “ni zU na mAtimatiM kayasya cittijizWABiH” 129, 5 “naro'BimAtiM kayasya cit” 8, 25, 15 ।
m: कय (Ved. for 2. क; only gen. sg. with चिद्), every one (e.g. नि षू नमातिमतिं कयस्य चित्, bow well down the haughtiness of every one, RV. i, 129, 5), RV. i, 27, 8; viii, 25, 15;

s: strI, (ko vAyuH sa iva vegena yAti aTavA kaM jalaM tasya srota iva yAti । ka + yA + qaH । tatra tizwati । sTA + kaH wAp ca .) vayasTA । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥ kAkolI iti KyAtA ॥
v: strI kaM jalaM yAti yA--qa taTA satI tizWati sTA ka । kAkolyAm kzIrasvAmI
m: कयस्था f. a medicinal plant, L.
कय्य m. N. of a prince (founder of a shrine and a Vihāra called after him), Rājat.
कय्यक m. N. of a man, Rājat.

a: कय्यट — Author of the भाष्यप्रदीप, being a commentary on Patañjali's महाभाष्य. He is considered by Dr. Buhler to be not older than the 13th century.
